scope: CVG-003 tenant-safe legacy audit coverage under NOBYPASSRLS

criteria.description: A forward audit_events policy gives a tenant read access to a NULL-account legacy row only when metadata.legacyAccountId exactly matches app.current_account_id().
criteria.limitations: This certifies the canonical repository migration source, not a target cluster rollout.

criteria.description: Legacy rows are read-only under tenant context: INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE require a non-null ordinary account_id equal to the active tenant, with no broad NULL-row visibility.
criteria.limitations: The proof is local and disposable; production policy state is not claimed.

criteria.description: The PostgreSQL proof uses the effective cvg_test_rls role with rolbypassrls=false and proves matching legacy inclusion, foreign legacy exclusion and no legacy rows without tenant context.
criteria.limitations: The disposable harness does not replace target role/connection validation.

criteria.description: The complete committed account snapshot remains beyond the old 100-row page boundary, preserves newest-first timestamp/ID ordering, and the repository compatibility branches reject a mis-tagged ordinary row.
criteria.limitations: This is limited to the audit snapshot/listing paths covered by the parent slice.

criteria.description: TDD and regression evidence is green: the unsafe-policy DML assertion and unguarded-repository predicate both failed intentionally, then the focused PostgreSQL proof passed 2/2, the audit module passed 27/27 and the full API passed 496/496.
criteria.limitations: Local test evidence does not certify remote CI or release environments.

criteria.description: Quality gates pass: official coverage is 80.09% statements/lines, 80.97% branches and 88.28% functions; RLS, migration-source, OpenAPI, secret and formatting checks are green.
criteria.limitations: Coverage is workspace-local and does not replace target observability or accessibility evidence.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only review inspected the migration, repository guards, restricted-role test and parent implementation and returned APPROVE with no findings.
